versions.content: {DRAFT} egressPort definition for SwitchStreamIdenti- fication If a SwitchStreamIdentification references one or more Cou- plingPort s in the role egressPort , then a frame is considered matching for this egress check if that frame is forwarded to all of the referenced CouplingPort s in the role egressPort . If a SwitchStreamIdentification references no CouplingPort s in the role egressPort , then a frame is considered matching for this egress check regardless to which CouplingPort s that frame is forwarded.
